differences_from_network: slack bound uses the cohort RATED energy (a Param) instead of the available energy (a Var in the ESSO): looser by the factor 1/SoH
EQUALITY_TOLERANCE is applied in MWh (ESSO units) where the network applies it in p.u. (x baseMVA MWh)
the ESSO objective is not divided by sigma in ADMM while the network objectives are: the same 1e3/MWh coefficient is not the same weight relative to the AL terms (reported, not resolved here)
closure_convention_implemented.esso_per_cohort: same form per (cohort, block, day), gated on the ESSO params.slacks (true in SRP1_ESS_Params.json): e[c,y,d,T] == 0.5*E_av[c,y] + up - down; 0 <= up, down <= 0.05*E_rated(c) + EQUALITY_TOLERANCE; PENALTY_SHARED_ESS_BALANCE per MWh in feasibility_penalty; without slacks the +-EQUALITY_TOLERANCE band
closure_convention_implemented.network_reference: model_construction_helpers.sess_soc_final_rule at HEAD: with params.slacks.shared_ess.day_balance (true in every SRP1 network params file): soc[T] == E*0.5 + slack_up - slack_down; slack in [0, E*ESS_DAY_BALANCE_SLACK_FRACTION (0.05) + EQUALITY_TOLERANCE] (configure_shared_ess_operational_state), objective baseMVA*PENALTY_SHARED_ESS_BALANCE*(up+down) = PENALTY_SHARED_ESS_BALANCE (1e3) per MWh; without day_balance: -EQUALITY_TOLERANCE <= soc[T] - 0.5E <= EQUALITY_TOLERANCE. E = the available energy handed to the network (sum over cohorts of es_e_available_per_unit)

independent_units.aggregation_q: es_qnet == sum_c q_c + slack_es_qnet_up - slack_es_qnet_down (E5), Q slack priced esso_slack_penalty per MVAr per period (as the P slack)
independent_units.degradation_objective: unchanged rows; objective gains only the Q-slack and closure-slack terms (Vars fixed at 0 outside multi-cohort node-years)
independent_units.h3: unwired: the energy_storage_cohort_pnet_share_h3 rows are not added (Param, empty ConstraintList and the configure function retained)
independent_units.new_rows: energy_storage_cohort_soc, energy_storage_cohort_soc_window (lower, upper), energy_storage_cohort_soc_final, energy_storage_cohort_converter (per (y_inv, y) inside the calendar-life window), energy_storage_operation_agg_q (per y,d,p); all built DEACTIVATED, registry model._esso_cohort_units_rows (not _esso_cohort_constraints)

independent_units.soc_row: e[c,y,d,p] == e_prev + eta_ch(c)*pch*dt - pdch*dt/eta_dch(c); e_prev = ENERGY_STORAGE_RELATIVE_INIT_SOC (0.5) * es_e_available_per_unit[c,y] at p = 0 (network sess_soc_rule coefficients; eta from the cohort installation-year SharedEnergyStorage, as the throughput row)

change_under_test.within_cohort_simultaneity: restricted exactly as in the single-cohort ESSO: no row; the EPS_ESSO_THROUGHPUT (1e-5) throughput regularization (same coefficient on pch and pdch) and the remedy-(h) IPOPT tolerances (ESSO_TOL_OVERRIDES tol 1e-10, acceptable_tol 1e-9); detector (i) measures it

deviations_declared_before_launch: T-ii (b): the ">= 0.20 MWh pre-charge of the 2-h cohort" is NOT imposed: its window headroom (0.9-0.5)*E_av <= 0.4*0.5*0.985^5 = 0.1854 MWh < 0.20 MWh (SRP1 data: eta_ch 0.97, eta_dch 0.96, phi 0.985, end-of-block SoH). The pre-charge is left to the solver (periods 0-5 free) and compared with the minimum needed s/eta_dch - 0.4*E_av ~ 0.075 MWh
T-ii: all periods of the test day other than the request period are free, so the per-cohort closure can be met; the rest of the model is fixed at 0 requests
T-iv: the peak is the midpoint 0.464 MW (the -0.5 MW peak is meetable with transfer only with a 0.0000-0.003 MW margin on these data); after the peak the request is free (recharge)
T-v: two starting points instead of two warm starts (see t_v.starts_note)

t_iii.profile_rule: swing = (0.5-0.1) * f * sum_c E_cal(c) with E_cal = E_rated * phi^(n*k) (calendar-only end-of-block, an upper bound on E_av); phases at rate_mw from period 0, each on a new period, last partial: discharge swing*eta_dch, charge 2*swing/eta_ch, discharge swing*eta_dch; every other period 0; all periods fixed

t_iv.control: every period of the day fixed 0 (no peak)
t_iv.peak_rule: peak = midpoint of no_transfer_max = sum_c min(s_c, 0.4*E_cal_c*eta_dch) and with_transfer_max = min(s_A, 0.4*E_A*eta_dch) + min(s_B, (0.4*E_B + gain)*eta_dch), gain = max(0, 0.4*E_A - s_A/eta_dch)*eta_dch*eta_ch (A = 2025 cohort, B = 2030 cohort, calendar-only E); periods before the peak fixed 0, after the peak free (recharge to the closure)
